text:
leo: heads-up  testing a compact stream meter that sits inline with the composer (tiny left badge) + icon-only stop next to send. goal: minimal height change. initial reactions?

anya: promising. two quick concerns: 1) screen-reader discoverability, 2) accidental regenerate taps on mobile.

priya: propose 2 prototypes: 1) tilde numeric ("~23") inside a 20px circle, 2) progress ring with tooltip. run accessibility quick pass on both.

ux-bot: checklist added to prototype doc: https://redwood.design/proto/compact-inline-meter. ARIA notes: aria-live="polite" for updates, offscreen text like "Tokens updating: approximately 23", throttle updates to 400ms. ensure 3:1 contrast for small badge text.

derek: keyboard mapping thought: current Esc stops/regens in many builds. recommend Esc = stop-only, Shift+Enter = regenerate, and offer a small tabbable stop icon with aria-label "Stop generation". avoid single-letter global shortcuts while typing.

leo: +1 on splitting keys. also microcopy: show muted "approximate while streaming" below badge, flip to "final tokens: 120" when done.

anya: prompt library overflow issue: on narrow widths the floating drawer covers the badge. move the prompt toggle into composer overflow on small screens and make drawer push canvas rather than overlap.

priya: perf nit: estimator runs on streamed deltas. debounce UI updates separately from render frames. sample: ```js
let t=0; function maybeBadge(n){ const now=Date.now(); if(now-t>400){ setBadge(n); t=now; } }
```

ux-bot: accessibility microcopy suggestions: streaming state = "Approximately 23 tokens (updating)"; final = "Generation complete  final tokens: 120". keep text short and in muted style.

derek: copy tweak: tooltips should say "Stop generation" (primary) and expose "Regenerate" in overflow to avoid accidental regen taps.

leo: decision list for next sprint: A/B prototype (tilde vs ring), aria-live at 400ms, move prompt toggle into composer overflow for narrow widths, change keyboard mapping (Esc stop-only, Shift+Enter regen), tabbable stop icon with screen-reader text, microcopy updates. i'll file tickets and tag design/research. :white_check_mark:
